name: M1: A Death in the Desert
source:
When M wakes up in an abandoned hotel, he has no memory of how he got there. In the bedside drawer, he finds a list with three names and a gun with three bullets, but what he does with this information is up to you. Embark on a violence-soaked post-apocalyptic adventure where the answers to your questions come at a price. How far will you go to discover the truth?

[from [url=https://frazilpop.itch.io/m1]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
M在一座废弃酒店里醒来，却不记得自己是怎么来的。他在床头抽屉里找到一张写着三个名字的名单，以及一把装有三发子弹的枪。但如何利用这些线索，由你决定。踏上一段充满暴力的末日后冒险，你想得到的答案都需要付出代价。为了查明真相，你会走多远？

[来源：[url=https://frazilpop.itch.io/m1]itch.io[/url]]
